name: In the Shade of a Sequoia
source:
Follow the story of Roscoe Conway --a new arrival to Echo struggling to step out from the long shadows of his past-- as he attempts to navigate his way to becoming the better man he wants to be. However, the roads of self-discovery and self-improvement are never without their fair share of hardships, and the mistakes of the past may not be so easily overcome...

[From [url=https://furlock.itch.io/sequoia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随罗斯科·康威 (Roscoe Conway) 的故事，他是Echo的新人，努力摆脱过去的长期阴影，努力成为他想成为的更好的人。然而，自我发现、自我完善的道路从来都充满艰辛，过去的错误也未必那么容易克服……

[来自[url=https://furlock.itch.io/sequoia]Itch.io[/url]]
